meta.title: Implement bill item DTO for pharmacy income report
meta.body_summary: Add PharmacyIncomeCostBillItemDTO and support DTO rows in income report to optimize pharmacy income and cost reporting by bill item.

perf_labels.notes: Merged in 25s without any human review; no performance evidence supplied; adds DTO and service methods for bill-item-based pharmacy income report.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 358 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor. As a performance optimization with no review, it was merged instantly by the author, consistent with low-risk, self-contained improvements.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced PharmacyIncomeCostBillItemDTO, added bill-item fetching logic in BillService, updated IncomeBundle and IncomeRow to support DTO rows, adjusted the report controller and JSF view to use the new DTO data.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining files involve data structure enrichment and UI adjustments to render bill-item details.
